lifecycle.design: A written mechanism and no contracts. Cannot be created.
lifecycle.building: The interface and specification exist; the contract path does not. Cannot be created.
lifecycle.ready: Deployed on Robinhood Chain, verified against it, and creatable through the interface.

models.name: Classic
models.summary: A fixed-supply token quoted in ether, with the swap fee written into the pool at creation and the launch position locked by a contract.

models.name: Stock-Paired
models.summary: The same market, quoted in a tokenized equity instead of ether — pair your token against NVIDIA, Apple, the S&P 500 or silver.

models.name: Evergreen
models.summary: A share of every fee is set aside and can be added back to the locked position as liquidity by anyone, forever.
